name: mcode-trajectory-studio
description: 只读查看本机 MiniMax Code 会话轨迹：轮次、步骤、LLM 与工具的墙钟耗时、token 用量、工具入参与结果、上下文拆分、压缩与子代理任务，并附带一个本地交互式面板。数据取自本地运行时自身的 SQLite 投影；插件不写入任何文件、不联网、不收集遥测。面板仅监听 127.0.0.1，每个 API 路由都要求一份随进程新生成的访问凭据。需要 Node.js 22.13.0+（内置 node:sqlite 的下限），已验证范围与 mcode engines 一致：>=22.19 <23 或 >=24 <27；全文检索另需内置 SQLite 带 FTS5，22.13.0-22.18.x 与 23.x 缺失时搜索降级并告警。 / Read-only inspection of local MiniMax Code session trajectories: turns, steps, LLM and tool wall-clock time, token usage, tool arguments/results, context breakdown, compactions, sub-agent tasks, plus a local panel. Data comes from the local runtime SQLite projection; the Plugin writes no files, no network, no telemetry. The panel listens on 127.0.0.1 only and requires a per-process capability token on every API route. Requires Node.js 22.13.0+ (the built-in node:sqlite floor); the verified range matches mcode engines: >=22.19 <23 or >=24 <27. Full-text search also needs FTS5 in that bundled SQLite; absent in 22.13.0-22.18.x and 23.x, where search degrades with a warning.
